description: Predicts server actions - general latency/ping effects optimizer now available on 1.16.5

mods.name: Eslium
mods.description: Predicts server actions to reduce latency effects

releases.notes:
Initial 1.21.11 port of Eslium.

Fixes:
- Fixed a startup crash where the config directory was null during client init (config is now resolved lazily through FabricLoader)
- Fixed the potion mixin targeting a method that no longer exists in 1.21.11
- Fixed a crash when opening the config screen caused by a duplicate background blur within a single frame
- Fixed a startup crash on older Fabric Loader builds (MixinExtras 0.5.0) triggered by a `@Redirect` on ClientPacketListener; the latency ping is now driven without it

Included:
- Full feature port from the 1.16.5 build
- Anchors, placement, throwables, tools, weapons, combat and consumables
- Elytras, firework, windcharge, interactables, redstone and cooldowns
- Pose, optout, swap, crystals and minecarts predictions
- Config parity with 19 sections plus simulatedDesync
- In-game configuration through Mod Menu (optional) or the rebindable config keybind
- A main config menu listing every prediction, with an on/off toggle on each row and a sub-menu opened by clicking the row for its individual settings
- README configuration documentation
